leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a TypeScript interface to define the structure of form data
Configure a form submit handler with proper TypeScript event typing
Apply type assertions to safely extract form values from event targets
Construct a function that processes form data with type-safe parameters
Initialize form state with TypeScript types to prevent runtime errors
Bind form inputs to typed state variables using controlled components
Manipulate form data through type-safe validation and transformation
